How to copy & paste a custom PDL

1. Send only the PDL in a chat message. Do not add other text, spaces, or characters.

2. On the watch, press and hold the message, then release it. A toast confirms the PDL was copied.

3. Open Custom PDL. Before opening the keyboard, press and hold the text field, then tap Paste.
